label: Spread
short: The estimated mix of regular or power users, occasional users, and non-users in a typical week.
strong: AI use reaches at least half of staff in a typical week. Team mode shows how deep.
middle: AI use sits with fewer than half of staff. Team mode shows where it spreads and where it stops.
edge: There are no regular or power users yet. Start with one person and one task: talk to a listed person.
unmet: Run team mode. It is the only honest way to know.
